name: United Arab Emirates

flag.description: A vertical red band at the hoist, with three equal horizontal stripes of green, white and black filling the rest of the flag.
flag.symbolism: The Pan-Arab colours are commonly said to stand for fertility (green), peace and neutrality (white), strength (black) and unity and courage (red).

hook: The UAE is the Pan-Arab tricolour with a vertical red bar at the hoist, not a triangle (Jordan, Palestine, Sudan) or a trapezoid (Kuwait).
trivia: The flag was designed in 1971 by Abdullah Mohammed Al Maainah, who was 19 at the time and won a public design competition.
The UAE marks Flag Day every year on 3 November.
The federation has seven emirates; Ras Al Khaimah joined in February 1972, a few weeks after the other six.
